offering_description.value: Amentum provides engineering, mission operations and digital services to government agencies and commercial customers. Its teams operate and maintain customer facilities, support defense and space programs, manage nuclear cleanup, and develop and secure software and IT systems.

primary_services.value: mission operations, logistics and maintenance; engineering, testing and systems integration; nuclear operations and environmental remediation; IT modernization and software development; cybersecurity and intelligence support

customer_segment.value: B2G: Defense and intelligence agencies, civilian agencies, space agencies and allied governments; B2B: Nuclear utilities, industrial facility operators and other government contractors

end_markets.value: defense and intelligence; civilian government; nuclear energy and environmental cleanup; aerospace and space; industrial operations

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Multiyear contracts and task orders for engineering, operations, technology and logistics work

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses engineering and technical staff to operate facilities and integrate systems for agencies and commercial clients

geography_served.value: global: United States, United Kingdom, continental Europe, the Middle East and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: Mission support, engineering, nuclear operations and cleanup, digital modernization and cybersecurity

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Competitive government bids, task orders and direct contracts with commercial customers; partners / resellers: Prime contractors and teaming partners on government programs

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Federal acquisition rules, defense export controls, security clearances and nuclear safety requirements govern contract work.
